evals.prompt: teacher-service đang bị 503, deploy nó lên Cloud Run đi
evals.expected_output: Skill walks through: check auth, verify secrets, run gcloud builds submit from rust-services/teacher-service/, then gcloud run deploy pixiai-teacher, then update TEACHER_SERVICE_URL on aero-backend. Provides copy-paste commands with correct project ID and region.

evals.prompt: Deploy cả teacher-service và exam-service lên Cloud Run. Dùng parallel build nếu được.
evals.expected_output: Skill handles multi-service deploy. Runs two Cloud Build jobs (ideally in background &), then deploys both, then updates both TEACHER_SERVICE_URL and EXAM_SERVICE_URL on aero-backend. Uses correct Cloud Run service names (pixiai-teacher, pixiai-exam).

evals.prompt: latex-service vừa deploy xong nhưng vẫn 503. Kiểm tra lỗi và fix.
evals.expected_output: Skill diagnoses 503 post-deploy: checks if LATEX_SERVICE_URL was updated on aero-backend, checks Cloud Run logs, checks if service cold-started. Provides gcloud logging read command and update-env-vars fix.
